contents.text: فحله ووجده قد عمل اللام الف حرفا واحدا
contents.note: 'fa-halluhu wa-wajadahu qad 'amila al-lam-alif harfan wahidan' = so he solved it and found that he had treated lam-alif as one letter (one sign)

contents.text: سالت خطا بالقبول يبين عن حظي لديك فزدت في هجراني / فعدوت محزونا اذون صبابة ثكلان قد قصب العدى بهواني
contents.note: verse (reading low-medium): 'sa'altu ... bi-l-qabul yubayyin 'an hazzi ladayka fa-zidta fi hijrani' = I asked ... acceptance to show my fortune with you, and you increased in forsaking me; 'fa-'adawtu mahzunan ... thaklan qad ... al-'ada bi-hawani' = so I went off grieving, ... bereaved, the enemies having ... through my humiliation; several words in both lines not secure

contents.text: وكتب الشيخ شهاب الدين المنجم للمخدوم بسط الله ظلاله فحل[ه؟]
contents.note: 'wa-kataba al-shaykh Shihab al-Din al-munajjim (or al-mutarjim; earlier pages have al-mutarjim, here the word looks like al-munajjim?) li-l-makhdum basata Allah zilalahu fa-hall[ahu?]' = and the shaykh Shihab al-Din, the astrologer(?)/translator, wrote to the master, may God spread his shade; so he solved ...; line ends in the catchword 'fahal-' and the sentence continues on the next page
